note: The nano98 driver catalog (user design 2026-11-21: a repository of supported drivers, archived like oldversions, maybe hosted later as redistributables). A system layer made from a driver names its catalog id (layer manifest 'driver'). Resolution: the local archive first (BROKENNES_N98_DRIVERS, else T:/BrokenDev/Archive/drivers, else %LOCALAPPDATA%/BrokenNes/nano98/drivers), then download_base (not set: no public hosting yet). Every file is checked against its sha256.
